body: The train's squash body is squash_commit_messages_body over the whole range, and the only lever is the PR-body 'aida: no-complete' marker, which stops auto-completion for the whole commit. Proposal for p16 until BUG-2635 lands: put the marker in the p16 PR body and complete TASK-3123, BUG-2588 and BUG-2603 by hand after landing. That is an interim exception to the no-permanent-marker ruling; the integration seat needs an OK before opening the PR in about 15 min. BUG-2635 is now tagged track:integration. It needs queuing with AIDA_TRACK=integration (dispatch authority), and then the integration seat launches it on dell1 as Opus on base integration.
subject: p16 needs interim no-complete (until BUG-2635); BUG-2635 routing
